html: † יַלְקוּט n.[m.] receptacle, wallet(?) (proposes collector) (on form cf. LagBN p. 127 BaNB § 156 b Köii. 1, § 76, 4)—only in 1 S 17:40 and he put them [the stones] בִּכְלִי הָרֹעִים אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ וּבַיַּלְקוּט in the shepherd’s receptable which he had, even (?) in the wallet (? such as every shepherd carried, hence art.); but prob. del. ו before בַּיַּל׳ (𝔊 The We Klo Bu HPS), and regard בִּכְלִי … לוֹ as gloss (We Bu HPS).
